LESSON: ASBAABU AN- NUZUUL (REASONS FOR REVELATION)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.4: Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation), part of Qur’an in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is the knowledge of asbaabu an- Nuzuul important to a muslim?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul for easy application of the Qur’an,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. assess the benefits of asbaabu an- Nuzuul for easy understanding of the Qur’an,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the role of Asbaabu an- Nuzuul in the interpretation the Qur’an.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

A. describe the kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul for easy application of the Qur’an,

B. assess the benefits of asbaabu an- Nuzuul for easy understanding of the Qur’an,

   Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate the role of Asbaabu an- Nuzuul in the interpretation the Qur’an.

   Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul (revelation in response to an event or a general situation,revelation in response to a particular question that has been asked by someone and revelation for other reasons,known or not known to us) and make notes

2. search online or from available reference materials on the benefits asbaabu an- Nuzuul and present in class

3. watch or listen to an audio- visual material of a resource person talking on kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul (revelation in response to an event or a general situation,revelation in response to a particular question that has been asked by someone and revelation for other reasons,known or not known to us) and make notes
2. search online or from available reference materials on the benefits asbaabu an- Nuzuul and present in class
3. watch or listen to an audio- visual material of a resource person talking on kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: the skills of interacting with technology and connecting using digital technology are enhanced as learners

search online or from available reference materials on the benefits asbaabu an- Nuzuul

• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and team work are enhanced as learners discuss

in small groups the benefits of asbaabu an- Nuzuul and make notes

• Learning to Learn: the skill of organising own learning is enhanced as learners make a presentation on the benefits of

asbaabu an- Nuzuul

Values:
● Responsibility: accountability is enhanced as learners search online or from available reference materials on the benefits

asbaabu an- Nuzuul and present in class

● Respect: etiquette is enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinion as they discuss the kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Parental Empowerment and Engagement: resource mobilisation and utilization are enhanced as learners listen to a

resource person giving a talk on kinds of asbaabu an- Nuzuul

2. assess the benefits of asbaabu an- Nuzuul for easy understanding of the Qur’an,
